machine_contract.principle: domain semantics compile inside bounded windows; machine services receive normalized propagation requests

hardening.transaction: state, receipt head, sequence head and recovery receipts commit in one atomic journal write
hardening.recovery: signal-id receipt cache verifies the complete replayed request against the original previous receipt
hardening.partitioning: state and receipt chains are partitioned by sha256(target)
hardening.ingress_auth: bearer token required and request authority must match configured trusted authority
hardening.service_state: systemd StateDirectory creates writable durable path before process start

identity_rule: BRAINK, KEX, CasePath, ClaimPath, workbook, site, carrier, projection and host remain distinct identities. They converge only on the canonical propagation ABI.
state_rule: visible state does not become authoritative until a COMMITTED receipt is returned or recovered for the exact same signal
proof_rule: hash chaining establishes consistency and lineage; it is not described as externally immutable without an independent witness
